name: Kristian Krattiger
line: Business technologist. I work on verification and grounding of AI output.
education: CSUF senior. BA Business Administration (Information Systems), minor in Computer Science.
education_source: author's brief (not re-verified against a record)
work_paragraph: I build systems where a model may propose but a deterministic check decides what gets admitted, and where the system says so out loud when it cannot support an answer. GIN is the frame. SEAR and Receipts with Assay are slices of it. Latch tested GIN's gate idea on small-model reasoning.
Some of it held on small sets. Some of it failed under criteria I wrote down before running it. Both sides are below, with the same weight, and each line links to its evidence.
work_paragraph_source: framing written for this site from the ledger entries it links to; 'GIN is the frame' and the slice list follow the author's vault note CALICHE/Projects/GIN/GIN.md; the Latch sentence follows Latch docs/HISTORY.md at cdcd512
